mentions.name: macOS Low Battery Reminder App
mentions.description: A tiny macOS app that provides proactive reminders about low battery and imminent shutdown. Instead of relying on the standard system notification that arrives around 10% battery, it displays an overlay window with text that follows the cursor and plays a custom sound so the reminder isn't missed.
mentions.problem: The standard macOS battery notification comes at about 10% and is often missed, resulting in the laptop shutting down in the middle of an ongoing video meeting before the user can act.
mentions.audience: A personal macOS utility for the author's own laptop use.
mentions.source_excerpt: Tinkering with a tiny macOS app that gives me proactive reminders about the low battery and imminent shutdown.
